name: ReviewOS – Post-Delivery Review Requests with Customer Photos: AI Photo Moderation, Judge.me Publishing & Ad-Ready UGC Library

parameters.content:
# ReviewOS – Post-Delivery Reviews with Customer Photos

For Shopify D2C brands whose product pages have a handful of text-only reviews, while the best customer photos sit in WhatsApp chats nobody saves. Asking manually doesn't scale, and checking every photo before it goes live takes time.

## How it works
Every day, customers whose order was delivered 3 to 10 days ago get a WhatsApp and email asking for a review, with one reminder later. The review form collects a rating, text, photos and ad consent. GPT-4o checks each photo and the text, so screenshots, stock images, wrong products and personal details never go live. Clean reviews are published to Judge.me with their photos, and doubtful ones go to Slack. Happy customers are thanked, and unhappy ones get a personal AI-written apology while your team is alerted. The best consented photos are saved to an ad-ready UGC folder.

## Setup steps
1. Add a Shopify custom-app token (`read_orders`) as Header Auth (`X-Shopify-Access-Token`).
2. Add your Judge.me private token as Query Auth, with parameter name `api_token`.
3. Connect OpenAI, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, Slack and WhatsApp Business Cloud.
4. Create **Review Requests** and **UGC Library** tabs and two Drive folders (review photos and ads UGC), and replace the `REPLACE_…` IDs.
5. Set your store and n8n domain in **Set Review Config**, then send yourself a test request.

## Schedule & Config
Runs every day at 11 AM IST. When to ask, when to remind and the daily cap are set in the config node.

## Delivered Orders
Finds orders delivered 3 to 10 days ago, skipping refunds and anything tagged `no-review`. Customers already asked are matched against the log so nobody is asked twice.

## Review Request
The customer gets a WhatsApp and an email with a personal link to the review form, and the request is logged.

## Reminder
Customers who haven't replied after 3 days get one gentle reminder. After that they're left alone.

## Form & Validation
The customer rates the product, writes a few lines, adds photos and says whether you can use them in ads. The link's token is checked so each order is reviewed once.

## AI Moderation
GPT-4o checks every photo: does it show the product they ordered, is it a screenshot or stock image, is anyone's personal info visible? It also checks the text for spam, profanity and personal details.

## Save Review Photos
Approved photos go to a Drive folder and are shared by link, so Judge.me can display them.

## Ad-ready UGC Library
Photos scoring high on quality and ad appeal, from customers who gave ad consent, are copied to an ads folder and logged with a caption idea. Your marketing team gets a Slack heads-up.

## Publish or Moderate
Clean reviews are published to Judge.me with their photos. Anything the AI wasn't happy with goes to Slack for a human to decide. Either way the request is updated.

## Thank or Recover
Happy customers (4 or 5 stars) get a thank-you. For 1–3 stars, the AI writes an apology that addresses their specific complaint, and the team is alerted in Slack.

## Credentials & Security
Shopify, Judge.me and WhatsApp keys live in n8n credentials. Photos are only used in ads with explicit consent. Shared Drive links are public, so only approved review photos go there, never rejected ones.

You are a caring customer-experience lead at an Indian D2C brand. A customer left a low rating. Write a short, sincere WhatsApp reply (max 320 chars, the customer's language if obvious, otherwise English). Acknowledge their specific issue, apologise without excuses, and offer a concrete next step (replacement, exchange or a call from our team). Do NOT ask them to change their review. No emojis except at most one.
Return ONLY JSON: {"message": string, "support_note": string (max 140 chars: what support should do)}
